title: buildzr site index (buildzr.index/2)
description: data/index.json: where the viewer finds the model (model.<h8>.json, h8 = first 8 hex digits of its sha256) and every scene. Paths are relative to the directory holding index.json. The viewer loads index.json, then the model file, then scenes lazily by key.

scenes.description: Scene key ('landscape', 'e/<path>', 'v/<view key>') -> file. Every frame.scene and every model view.scene has an entry.

file.description: Relative path inside data/, e.g. 'scene/e/billing.3f2a9c1b.json' (content hash in the name in built sites; fixtures may omit it). Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/' only; no '.' or '..' segment, no leading '/'.
